description:
Want to join a company that works on real world problems that make a difference to people’s lives? We are focused on changing how we build what’s around us, helping people to design and construct buildings and infrastructure more efficiently.
 
Do you have experience of large capital projects in the built environment? Are you passionate about leading data-centric solutions to solve the frustrations and complex problems faced by the industry? We want to hear from you.
 
Interested? Read on!
_____________________________________________________________________________________
We are Laminar Projects!
 
We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it)
 
We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.
 
The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 200 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job”, we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.
 
Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life: 
  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 
 
4 core values for a good life
 
We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.
 
We are achieving this vision through the following two missions:  
  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society
_____________________________________________________________________________________
The Role
 
Purpose of the role
We are looking for experienced Digital Consultants to join our team. You will leverage your industry experience to deeply understand clients' problems, advise them on best practice and deliver data-driven digital solutions tailored to their needs. You will be a proactive individual who directs technical teams to deliver impactful results and excels at communicating complex concepts to less technical audiences.
 
Team 
The Data & Digital team helps people to use data effectively to improve the performance of their projects or organisations. To do this effectively and at scale we use the modern digital technologies including Azure, Fabric, Power BI and Python. We pride ourselves on being structured and outcome driven, helping us to build the best solutions and helping us to continuously improve what we do.
 
Your top 5 responsibilities
  1. Solve our clients’ most complex business problems: Develop data-driven digital solutions tailored to clients' needs by fully understanding their business processes and challenging the status quo.
  2. Implement best practice data solutions: Work with our technical experts and lead junior team members to deliver to clients’ expectations by successfully communicating complex business concepts and requirements.
  3. Develop internal Laminar data solutions: Helping Laminar to become data driven by leveraging digital technologies to collect organisation data and enhance operational efficiency.
  4. Productisation of client solutions: Work with our technical teams to develop products that work across different clients.
  5. Following and developing our processes: Following our best practices and identifying areas for us to improve by refining or introducing new processes.
 
Your Capabilities
As a candidate, you should have: 
  • Degree educated in one of the following: Engineering, Surveying, Project Management, or similar.
  • 5+ years experience in the engineering/construction of large capital projects (>USD 100m).
  • 2+ years experience driving data and digital solutions set up and implementation across an organisation or large project.
  • Great communication skills, able to translate complex ideas in a clear and concise manner to a wide variety of audiences.
  • Demonstrable passion for digital transformation and improving the delivery of Capital Projects, with the curiosity to learn the latest digital tools and processes across project life cycle.
  • Have an analytical mindset and be able to create structure and clarity from uncertainty. 
 
It would also be great if you have: 
  • Chartered in relevant body (e.g. ICE, RICS) or moving towards chartership.
  • PMP/APM membership and/or MBA.
  • Consultancy experience.
  • Working knowledge of information management best practice.
  • Product Management/Software development experience.
  • Experience with BI tools (e.g. Power BI).
  • Experience with databases (e.g. SQL, Azure) 
 
Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 
  • You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
_____________________________________________________________________________________
Benefits 
 
The standard stuff:  
- Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage – for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority  
- Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term – plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings  
- Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future – with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance  
- Professional body membership. One fee covered per year – so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft  
- Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels – and do your bit for the environment  
 
The life-changing stuff: 
- In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally – professionally and as a human being 
- Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future – and own a piece of it 
- Flexible working. Work where it makes sense – most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins 
- Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up 
_____________________________________________________________________________________
Important! Applying properly
 
We get hundreds of applications so please ensure your CV one or two pages. You will also be asked the following questions: 
  • What new opportunities or experiences are you seeking in this role that your current position hasn’t provided?
  • Describe a complex business problem you recently solved through a data-driven solution and what was the impact to the project or organisation. 
 
We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders.
 
You must be located and have the current right to work in the UK. We can support the transfer of existing UK visas, but cannot sponsor new visas.
 
In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

title: Senior Sales Executive - New Business
description:
About Smartnumbers

We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. 
 
We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. 
 
We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys. Together, we protect some of the UKs largest banks, insurance companies and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people into high performing teams.


What you'll be working on

We're looking for someone to build out a long term 2–3 year strategic pipeline. As part of the role, you will be expected to do the following: 
 

  • Build and maintain a 12–18 month active pipeline to support business objectives
  • Build and maintain relevant market awareness through client discussions, market research and industry events
  • Provide senior management with clear updates, progress and forecasts as evidenced through the company CRM
  • Nurture the customer advocacy program in support of our broader business goals
  • Prioritise activities to meet quarterly business targets while maintaining a longer-term strategic pipeline

What you’ll achieve 

You’ll be helping us achieve our mission by enabling fraud investigators across organisations to collaborate in their fight against fraud using our SaaS platform. The types of areas you’ll look at include: 
  • New Business Development
  • Leading client facing discover conversations to establish key business issues
  • Understanding and navigating the different approaches to fraud prevention across different sectors
  • Helping Clients build business cases for Smartnumbers adoption
  • Sharing intelligence and best practice across organisations
  • Increasing market awareness by supporting events, posts or other GTM activities
  • Building trust and a network of advocates among your client base

How you’ll work 

You’ll be part of an empowered cross functional go to market team that leverages best practice and seeks continual improvement. You’ll be given the freedom to manage your own time with support and guidance from senior sales leadership. You’ll be expected to build, maintain and report on a clear 12–18 month runway of pipeline with dedicated time set aside each week for strategic focus and execution on new business development.


What you'll need for the role

Smartnumbers values diversity of experience. Candidates should have a strong combination of several of the following skills, competencies and experience: 
 

  • Numbers Obsessed – You live and breathe your pipeline and progress and take pride in its resilience and accuracy.
  • Curious - You want to understand the problems our customers face and how we might solve them. You’re always looking for new opportunities to learn about our customers, the market, competitors, technology, etc.
  • Customer Focused - You start with the customer and work back whilst understanding that solutions have to work for our business
  • Outcome focused - You can define what success looks like and measure progress towards it
  • A clear communicator - You’re capable of explaining things regardless of whether it’s to a software engineer, salesperson, customer support agent or CEO


What we can offer you

As well as a competitive salary of circa £100,000 per annum, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, covering a variety of areas, both professional and personal. These benefits include:  

  • Hybrid working style, with the expectation of two days in the office (with a great City of London office base!)
  • Family friendly benefits including paid parental leave policies
  • An extensive health insurance policy for you, with an option to add your family members 
  • A workplace pension with Hargreaves Lansdown 
  • Life insurance of 4 x your salary 
  • Weekly self-development time to spend exploring your professional development interests
  • 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays), your birthday off, and an opportunity to buy up to 5 days annual leave per year
  • A holistic wellbeing support plan encompassing a variety of offerings to assist you. We provide you with a monthly £50 allowance to fund activities to best support your wellbeing as well as workshops and training to provide tools and guidance. Additionally, there is a wide-ranging employee assistance programme available to advise on personal, family or financial matters, and fun social events during the year.


The application process

We have a simple 3 stage application process: 

  1. 30-minute phone call with the hiring manager
  2. 1 hour interview and presentation
  3. HR and Bar Raiser Interview 
 
Smartnumbers is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. You will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, neurodiversity, gender, gender identity, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation. We welcome all applications for this role.  
 
We are committed to providing reasonable support/adjustments in our recruiting processes. If you need support, please reach out to the hiring contact. 
 
Please see our privacy notice: https://smartnumbers.com/privacy-notice

title: Senior Finance Manager
description:
About Numan 
 
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
 
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
 
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 
 
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
 
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The Role: 
 

We are looking for an experienced, audit-trained finance professional to own the month-end close, financial control, finance operations and statutory reporting at Numan.

This role owns the integrity of our numbers: the month-end close, the external audit and statutory accounts, day-to-day finance operations including invoice processing, banking, treasury and tax and the controls that sit behind them. Working closely with the Director of Finance and the wider Finance team and building strong relationships with teams across the business, you will strengthen our control environment and build processes that scale.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants ownership of the core of a growing finance function, to raise the standard of financial control and to shape how a fast-paced evolving business is run.


What you'll do:

  • Audit: Own the year-end audit and statutory accounts and be the main contact for our auditors.

  • Month end: Own the month-end close and make it faster and more accurate as the business grows.

  • Controls: Close out audit recommendations and build a controls framework fit for the next stage of the business.

  • Business partnering: Work closely with the FP&A team towards a common goal of accurate, timely numbers, and with the wider business to build controls into how we buy, spend and pay.

  • Technical accounting: Lead on complex accounting areas and any changes in accounting standards.

  • Finance operations and tax: Oversee invoice processing, payments, banking, cash forecasting, VAT, corporation tax and R&D claims.


    • You'll have:

  • ACA qualification, with audit training at a Big Four or mid-tier firm.

  • Post-qualification experience as a Finance Manager or in a similar role within a high-growth business.

  • Experience leading or supporting an external audit and preparing statutory accounts.

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge

  • A track record of improving the month-end close, controls and finance processes as a business evolves.

  • Experience implementing finance systems and automation, with an AI-first approach to reducing manual work.

  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with Xero or  similar.

  • The ability to communicate clearly with auditors, advisers and non-finance stakeholders.

  • High standards of accuracy, real ownership of the numbers and the confidence to challenge constructively.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


    • It's a bonus if you have:

title: Senior Growth Analyst
description:
Level Up Your Career!
 
At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.
 
At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5.

Kwalee’s Growth Analytics team is looking for a Senior Growth Analyst  to be the early-warning radar and the money brain of our mobile portfolio. Whenever the data hints at a problem or an opportunity, you’ll help us see it, size it, and act on it fast.

You go way beyond reporting. You’re the kind of analyst who says: “Here’s an opportunity, here’s why it’s happening, here are three ways to win it, and I’ll check next week how we did.”

This role is based onsite 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation. 

What You’ll Do:
  • Be our early-warning radar. Build smart, automated monitoring across revenue, spend, ROAS, and retention so the right people know what’s changing, quickly.
  • Build the money models. Create and improve the LTV and ROAS models that guide our UA targets.
  • Guide where the money goes. Help UA find where the next pound of spend works hardest across games and channels.
  • Detect, diagnose, recommend. When something moves, find out why, put a number on it, and bring clear options.
  • Prove what works. Help the whole team measure the real impact of their work, so we learn from every win.
  • Level up creative testing. Help design how we test and pick winning ads, and the dashboards that track them.
  • Tell the story. Share clear, simple insights with the team and leadership.

    • What You’ll Own:

    Portfolio insight and commercial modelling. You’ll be the first to spot what’s changing across our games, put a number on it, and bring a clear recommendation; you’ll keep our LTV models fresh so every UA decision stands on solid ground.

    How we’ll celebrate your success:

  • How early we spot changes, and how useful the alerts are.
  • Accuracy of LTV forecasts.
  • Value of the recommendations the team acts on.
  • How clearly we can see the impact of our work.

    • What We’re Looking For:
    Essential
  • Several years of analytics experience in mobile games or another app business with paid acquisition.
  • Strong SQL and Python (or R); you enjoy building models, not just queries.
  • Hands-on experience with LTV prediction, cohort analysis, and ROAS modelling.
  • A solid grasp of experiment design and statistics.
  • Commercial instinct: you talk in outcomes and recommend actions. 
  • A clear communicator who makes data easy for everyone.
    • Desirable
  • Experience building automated monitoring or anomaly detection is a big plus.
  • Familiarity with mobile attribution and ad data.

    • Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.

Job Title: Delivery & Business Operations Director - Football

Company: Hawk-Eye Innovations Ltd

This is one of the most important leadership roles within Hawk-Eye Football. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, the Delivery & Business Operations Director is responsible for building a world-class delivery organisation capable of executing strategic priorities, customer programmes and technology deployments across the global football business.

The role will establish and lead the Football PMO while acting as the Managing Director’s strategic delivery lead, ensuring strategic priorities are translated into successful execution. The Delivery & Business Operations Director will anticipate issues, solve complex operational problems and ensure that the organisation consistently delivers to world class standards.

Key activities that the role will focus on:

  • Lead strategic cross-functional initiatives on behalf of the Managing Director, taking ownership from concept through execution and ensuring delivery against agreed business outcomes

title: Senior software engineer - 6 month O/IR35
description:
This role is remote within the UK, and we're looking for engineers available quickly to join us for 6 months under O/IR35 requirements.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

Our culture:

Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability.

Be generous & candid - We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

 

Our engineering ways of working:

  • Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.

  • The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.

  • We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.

  • Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in TypeScript and Node.js, with MongoDB as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.

  • Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.

  • We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

 
 

The role

As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go-to’ person for queries.

 

On a typical day you will…

  • Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer-facing and operations teams

  • Design, implement and operate your services within your domain

  • Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements

  • Maintain and extend documentation for your services

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate

  • Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers

  • Communicate with non-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

 

What you need…

  • To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build-and-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.

  • We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.

  • Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.

  • Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability.

  • Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.

  • Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high-quality, standards-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.

  • Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.

  • Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.

  • Willing to be on-call for your services.

 

Core technical skills you must have:

  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js, specifically TypeScript

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services

  • Experience with Serverless products

  • Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB

  • Experience mentoring engineers

  • Experience leading technical delivery in a build-and-run engineering model

  • Experience in a structured on-call process and incident management

  • Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

 

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

We're looking for an AI-native Senior Product Designer to help drive the design of our Sexual Health experience — one of Hims & Hers' founding and highest-engagement categories. You'll partner closely with Design, Product Management, Clinical, and Engineering to design a best-in-class telemedicine experience across the sexual health journey, from first visit through ongoing treatment.

This role sits at the intersection of two mandates: sharpening what already exists and defining what comes next. You'll spend real time in the current app — refining flows, fixing friction, and raising the visual and interaction bar on existing features — while also using AI-native design tools and workflows to prototype and pressure-test where the sexual health experience should go over the next several product generations. You should be equally comfortable shipping a polished iteration this sprint and sketching a bolder, AI-shaped version of the product for next year.

You are a user-centric designer and problem solver who is motivated, ego-free, and always looking to improve, ideate, and refine. You're comfortable being both strategic and executional, working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment, and translating dense, sensitive, and often stigmatized subject matter into design that feels simple, human, and trustworthy.

You Will:

  • Elevate the Current Product Own and iterate on the sexual health app experience today — flows, journey maps, wireframes, and high-fidelity visual design across onboarding, diagnosis intake, treatment selection, refills, and check-ins. Identify friction, inconsistency, and drop-off in the existing product and design measurable improvements. Lead large initiatives or multiple concurrent projects with autonomy.

  • Design with AI, Natively Bring an AI-native workflow to your craft — using AI tools for research synthesis, rapid concept generation, prototyping, and content/copy exploration — to move faster from insight to tested concept. Explore how AI-powered features (personalization, triage, guided decision-making, ongoing care support) could become part of the sexual health product itself, not just part of how you design it.

  • Build Toward the Future App Translate where sexual health care is headed into concrete product direction. Partner with Product and Clinical to define a longer-term vision for the category, and design the connective tissue between today's app and that future state — so every current iteration is also a step toward it.

  • Champion the User Deeply understand the needs, anxieties, and behaviors of people seeking sexual health care — a category where trust, discretion, and empathy are as important as usability. Participate in customer research, testing, and iteration to ensure the product isn't just easy to use, but reduces stigma and builds confidence at every step.

  • Collaborate and Communicate Partner with Design, Product Managers, Research, Clinical, and Engineering to navigate complex, sensitive problems and drive projects from start to finish. Develop deep product and category expertise, become a trusted partner to stakeholders, and communicate decisions and process with clarity and empathy.

You Have:

  • 5+ years in a UX or Product Design role, leading design alongside cross-functional partners in Product, Engineering, and Research

  • Hands-on experience designing with AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow (research, ideation, prototyping, or content generation), or strong enthusiasm and aptitude for adopting one

  • A holistic approach to design, from category-level strategy down to pixel-level detail

  • Comfort designing for sensitive, high-stigma subject matter with empathy and discretion

  • A self-starter who is solution-oriented and comfortable defining, scoping, and designing for new opportunities with or without input from others

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present decisions and process clearly and confidently

  • Enthusiasm for growth and feedback, and the ability to work well with designers of all levels

  • Adaptability and excitement for working in a fast-paced environment

  • Solid visual craft with an eye for detail

  • Expert proficiency in Figma

Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience building products 0-to-1 in a startup

  • You have a passion for motion design, specifically as it relates to interaction

  • Previous experience in telehealth, pharma, or healthcare

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
AI is being run everywhere, by humans and agents. Harmonic Security governs all of it. The AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform understands user / agent intent and data context in real time, giving security teams visibility and control across every tool and workflow so companies can move faster with AI while minimizing risk.

We operate in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech: the emerging intersection of AI and cybersecurity. It's a market still being defined, and we're among the first to build natively for it - protecting sensitive data in real time, at the endpoint, with minimal friction for the teams using it. Enterprises get full visibility and control. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

Named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, Harmonic is gaining serious recognition and serious traction. We're led by deep cybersecurity expertise and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel.

As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work — from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Role

You'll play a key role in helping prospective and existing customers understand how Harmonic can address their unique challenges.

Your days will be a mix of engaging with prospects and existing clients to demonstrate the capabilities of our product through technical storytelling, building proof of value (POV) plans, and executing them smoothly and successfully. Our Solutions Architects are experts in bridging the gap between the customer and our product and engineering teams, ensuring that real-world customer requirements are clearly understood, helping to drive the evolution of our product.

Success in this role means building strong relationships with customers, guiding them through their AI adoption journey, and ensuring they feel confident and empowered to use Harmonic’s solution to its fullest potential.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible and accountable for all pre-sale technical activities

  • Collaborate closely with customers to create and execute tailored POCs that highlight how Harmonic simplifies data protection for the GenAI era

  • Work as part of the EMEA/DACH sales team to close new business opportunities and support existing customers through the lifetime of their contracts

  • Work closely with product and marketing to turn deep technical insights into compelling content and messaging

  • Stay on top of the competitive landscape to help shape our story and spotlight what makes Harmonic stand out

What You Bring

  • A proven track record in a solutions architect, solutions engineering, or pre-sales engineering role in the enterprise security space

  • Hands-on, day-to-day experience with AI productivity tools — both browser-based (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) and application-integrated (Claude, Claude Cowork, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) — and a practical understanding of how these tools handle sensitive data in enterprise environments

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-moving environments. Highly organized, able to manage competing priorities and a high volume of concurrent engagements, context-switch quickly, and make sound judgment calls about where to focus without waiting for direction

  • Hands-on experience deploying and managing software in enterprise environments, including working with MDM solutions such as Intune, JAMF, and Kandji

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. Confident using new tools and environments, and troubleshooting live issues under pressure

  • Scripting experience (Python, shell, PowerShell, or similar)

  • A proactive, hands-on mindset. You take ownership, solve problems independently, step up for new challenges, and support the people around you

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Experience in customer-facing post-sales roles such as technical customer engineering or technical account management

  • Familiarity with value-driven solution selling. Able to connect technical capabilities directly to customer business outcomes and articulate ROI throughout the sales cycle

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.

  • Recognized momentum - We made the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, a signal that the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity - Join early in a category-defining company at the convergence of AI and security, where your work directly shapes how enterprises tackle one of the biggest unsolved problems in tech

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity - A real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits - 401K, pension plan, generous PTO, and flexible hybrid work

  • A small, high-trust team that values transparency, creativity, and continuous learning - no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership - that cares deeply about your growth, not just your output

  • Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

title: Compliance Advisory Manager (1st line)
description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

You'll join our Operational Controls team within the Service guild, the backbone of how Griffin stays compliant and keeps operational risk visible and manageable as we scale. Working closely with Protect (our second line) and across all operations functions, you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance support looks like here, keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow.

The Service Guild at Griffin is the mindful engine room, driving our success. We strive to bring joy to our customers, both internal and external, through systems that just work.

There are four core elements to operations at Griffin: fincrime, payments, treasury ops and operational resilience. Across all teams, we place significant emphasis on compassion, ownership and curiosity. You will be empowered to make meaningful decisions and supported to make sure we collectively get those decisions right.

The opportunity

We want compliance built into how we design, sell and run our products. As our hands on compliance adviser in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into.

What success looks like

In your first year, our operations, sales and product teams bring you in early by default, because working with you makes things smoother, not slower. You've guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. Our live products have clear governance and outcome monitoring, and Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation in place.

To do this you'll be involved in:

  • Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments from first idea through product approval to launch.

  • Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures.

  • Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material.

  • Marketing: working on both our marketing materials and ensuring that our customer's marketing materials are compliant with regulation and our own internal policies. Also ensuring that our own financial promotions are compliant and challenged appropriately.

  • Service (Operations): building regulatory requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use.

  • Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time.

  • Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes.

  • Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge.

We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • Compliance experience in the first or second line of a UK regulated firm, ideally a bank, e-money institution or payments firm.

  • Practical knowledge of the rules behind our products, like Consumer Duty, BCOBS, CASS, FISMA, the Payment Services Regulations and the Money Laundering Regulations.

  • A hands on approach. You've turned regulation into practical requirements for product, sales or operations teams, and you're comfortable interpreting and applying FCA rules to new situations.

  • A curious, questioning approach. You know the right questions to ask before signing something off, not just the rules to check it against.

  • The confidence to challenge, clearly and kindly, when something isn't right.

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write).

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have deep expertise in at least one specialist area, such as payments, cards, Consumer Duty, BCOBS, financial promotions or similar.

  • Have worked in finance or Banking.

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: £ 80-90 (DOE)

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team.

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

  • Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation.

  • Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme 

  • Central London location


EEO Statement

title: Move to New Zealand - Technical Strategist (Solution Architect)
description:
Work alongside our innovative team based in Auckland, New Zealand! We are seeking talented individuals excited about the opportunity to learn, expand their skillset and support our company.

Propellerhead hires exceptional talent from all around the globe and many of our people have relocated to New Zealand to join our team. We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country.

The Role: 

At Propellerhead, the Technical Strategist role focuses on the delivery of resilient software systems that power everything from complex infrastructure to innovative new platforms. This role works alongside our Product Strategists to shape the technical specification and platform direction for a portfolio of client products.

We’re looking for someone who combines architectural insight with a strong hands-on engineering background and a genuinely AI-native way of working. You will have spent the formative part of your career as a software developer and still be confident with understanding the structure of software solutions. You'll have knowledge of emerging trends and you are agentic-first where you reach for AI to rapidly prototype new ideas and judge their value in hours, not weeks, and you are at home with directing an AI-assisted delivery pipeline.

You will lead and guide the design of complex systems, and we'll depend on your extensive experience, judgement and insights to ensure that early delivery and continuous improvement is possible. You’ll be applying and reinforcing Engineering standards for programming, and shape the technical solutions our AI-assisted pipeline builds, in a lean and evolutionary manner. Importantly, you will be responsible for ensuring that client platforms align with our technical strategy. You will work closely with the Chief Technologist and Engineering Principal to apply standards, patterns, and tooling in client contexts, and provide informed input into technical strategy through client platform insights and delivery experience.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.

If you're looking to contribute your insight and engineering experience to projects that matter - we would like to hear from you.


Skills & Experience Required:
  • 8+ years of experience with the development of multi-tier and distributed applications. 
  • Agentic-first: very comfortable using AI to rapidly prototype, shape solutions, and direct an AI-assisted delivery pipeline across requirements, testing and code generation. This is central to the role.
  • A confident, credible communicator and presenter in front of senior client stakeholders.
  • Our current technologies include React user interfaces, with services written in C#, so previous experience with both is essential. However we also have Typescript, Java, Go and Rust services, so you will need to show confidence in working with a variety of programming languages.
  • Strong communication skills must be demonstrable, with tangible examples of your skills to bridge technical solutions with business needs and present these concepts to a variety of internal and customer stakeholders. 
  • Hands-on experience with designing solutions on Azure is essential, including active participation in building CI/CD pipelines and instrumenting for operations, is required.
  • Experience with streaming and messaging platforms, such as Kafka or NATS, is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in leading the design of complex software applications, preferably for corporate enterprise, where solutions comprise existing services alongside custom development.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You will represent Propellerhead in front of stakeholders, so a professional, confident presence and the ability to communicate and influence with clarity are essential.
  • We are particularly looking for technical leaders with experience or demonstrable interest in any of the following: digital identity, verifiable credentials, open banking, AI agent authorization, edge or device-based software deployment.

    • Responsibilities:
  • Authoring, reviewing and communicating solution architecture and specifications in collaboration with the Development teams and our core Engineering team.
  • Championing the technical strategy of Propellerhead as our key business differentiator, and aligning design and implementation of the solutions in your portfolio in line with that technical vision.
  • Building trusted relationships with key client decision-makers. You will be responsible for ensuring our teams understand technical requirements and for clearly explaining our solution design to client technologists.
  • You will be the go-to technical person for our client’s solutions, including facilitating any technical pre-requisites for delivery or addressing improvements from operational feedback.
  • Developing strategies to ensure quality measures such as speed-to-value, security, reliability, maintainability, performance and functional fit for purpose.
  • Specifically, you will be facilitating the evolution of our code base from C# to Rust and the ecosystem of tools, practices and services that implies, with AI central to how we handle requirements, testing and code generation.

    • About Propellerhead:

    Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

    How We Build Software:

    We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

    Benefits:

    • Be part of an innovative team, with a culture of learning and collaboration.

    • Contribute to interesting, diverse, and commercially minded work for well-respected clients.

    • Opportunity for professional growth and development.

    • Fortnightly knowledge sharing sessions, with lunch.

    • Competitive salary. Employee Share Purchase Scheme offering.

    • This role is Auckland based, regular in-office attendance is required. Work within our beautifully designed office and from home (hybrid working model).

    • Propellerhead is an equal opportunity workplace which is free from discrimination.

     

    Cover Letter:

    *Please note - only applications with a cover letter will be reviewed.

    It's very important to us that you include a cover letter with your application - it's your chance to tell us more about who you are and what you value.

    At Propellerhead, we use AI thoughtfully as part of our delivery practices - considered integration helps us stay at the forefront of technology and create innovative, valuable solutions for our clients.

title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer - Productivity
description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Dans ce contexte, l’application permet aux utilisateurs d’uploader de nombreux types de fichiers (PDF, Word, images, etc) à partir de nombreuses sources.

L’objectif du stage est d’améliorer les outils présents dans l’application pour visualiser et manipuler ces documents. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Visualiser les PDF mais également d’autres types de documents (Word, images, etc) directement dans le navigateur, d’une manière scalable et sécurisée,
  • Ajouter plus d’options pour configurer la visualisation (zoom, recherche, orientation, etc),
  • Superposer le texte issu de l’OCR au document original afin de permettre à l’utilisateur de sélectionner et copier le texte,
  • Ajouter des fonctionnalités de découpage, fusion, et de changement d’ordre des pages,
  • Et d’autres fonctionnalités !

Ces fonctionnalités sont disponibles à travers toute l’expérience de Doctrine autour des documents privés, y compris dans l’Assistant, les dossiers collaboratifs, et les outils spécialisés tels Flow Litigate et Flow Counsel.

Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Productivity, et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).


Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. Bonus Points

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

title: Propulsion GSE Team Leader
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced and talented Propulsion Ground Support Equipment Team Leader, to lead the development, commissioning and operation of our engine test benches that we use to test our cryogenic engines and storable thrusters.

This is a key leadership role that requires technical expertise in liquid-propellant propulsion systems, a strong track record in managing complex engineering projects, and proven experience in leading and mentoring technical teams. The GSE Team Leader role for Liquid Propulsion Testing drives the end-to-end lifecycle – from initial concept and fluid/structural design to fabrication, commissioning, and operation – of critical ground infrastructure supporting liquid propellant rocket engine test campaigns.

As the GSE Team Leader, you will oversee the design, development and building of propulsion test facility. The primary objective is to develop and maintain robust, high-reliability test bench GSE that meets ambitious program cadences while ensuring absolute safety in hazardous operating environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the engineering development of new test facility GSE, including high-pressure gas distribution systems, propellant feed systems, electrical network, control and data acquisition system, mechanical structures, etc.

  • Translate test matrix requirements into hardware specifications, master P&IDs, and fluid system architectures

  • Manage a cross-functional team of mechanical, fluid, and instrumentation engineers and technicians

  • Direct resource allocation across multiple test benches, manage development schedules, and ensure alignment between propulsion design teams and facility operations

  • Oversee the structural fabrication, tube bending, welding, and mechanical assembly of GSE lines, panels, and thrust measurement structures

  • Lead high-pressure proof testing, leak checks, and system commissioning/decommissioning phases

  • Establish protocols for handling hazardous fluids (both cryogenic and storable propellants)

  • Enforce strict compliance with oxygen compatibility, system passivation, and precision cleanliness levels

  • Manage data acquisition and control systems (DAQ/DCS) engineers and technicians to integrate sensors (pressure transducers, thermocouples, flow meters) and remote-actuated valves into the GSE infrastructure for automated test sequences and redline monitoring

  • Author structural and fluid safety calculations, hazard analyses, and standard operating procedures

  • Maintain rigorous configuration control of test pad setups to ensure repeatable test conditions and audit readiness.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering

  • Equivalent technical experience with a proven track record in complex fluid systems engineering may be considered

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in rocket propulsion testing, launch pad operations, or high-pressure chemical processing plants

  • At least 2 years of experience leading engineering or technical teams

  • Advanced proficiency in developing and interpreting complex fluid schematics (P&IDs)

  • Strong working knowledge of industrial fluid component selection (valves, regulators, check valves, etc.)

  • Experience with 3D CAD modeling (NX, CATIA, or SolidWorks) for GSE packaging

  • Experience with fluid simulation tools

  • Knowledge of precision cleaning techniques for aerospace applications

  • Decisive leadership under high-pressure testing schedules

  • Exceptional risk-assessment capability

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to diverse audiences

  • Capacity to travel to test sites and partner facilities as required

  • Fluency in English.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.
